review.why: Researches social discussion so every claim points to the inspected material, with duplicates counted once and gaps reported.
review.summary: Method for read-only research on public or user-supplied social material: set the protocol first, treat search results as discovery-only, record each inspected part as an evidence record, group reposts, attribute comments, build a claim table with locators, report counts and access gaps. It can also audit an existing report.
strengths: A discovery-only record never supports a claim about uninspected content
Reposts and cross-posts count once as support
Access gaps are reported: an empty search is not proof of absence
cautions: No collection tooling: it assumes the agent can browse or has exports
The three reference files are described, not read here
